name: Molecular and Cell Biology PhD
summary: Interdisciplinary molecular and cell biology PhD with first-semester research rotations before choosing a thesis laboratory.

publishedDeadlines.label: Doctoral application
publishedDeadlines.note: Department lists an annual date without a year; no confirmed Fall2027 countdown.

detailsNote: Official doctoral deadline is undated. Admissions are fall-only; the later year-round and GPA text under PSM is not used as doctoral policy.

applicationFee.note: The department offers no waivers. Central waivers cover named affiliations, qualifying UConn enrollment or immediate progression, and US military service. These are conditional, not a general hardship offer; international applicants must confirm an eligible category before relying on a waiver.

english.note: Central minimums; PTE60. Agency delivery,two-year validity. TOEFL Essentials/MyBest/ITP (except UConn ITP), IELTS General/Indicator/One Skill Retake excluded. US citizens/permanent residents, primary-English applicants, an entire English-medium non-US degree documented by the Registrar/Controller, or qualifying US graded coursework can be exempt. US coursework requires30 undergraduate/combined or18 graduate credits and GPA3; non-graded courses excluded. TA oral-English rules are separate.

documents: University transcript copies,including originals and English translations where applicable
Personal statement (less than 1000 words) describing goals,research experiences and interests,2–3 faculty,and relevant context
requirements.note: Central bachelor-equivalent/GPA policies apply:3.0 prior degree,3.0 last two undergraduate years,3.5 last undergraduate year,or3.0 qualifying post-degree semester. MCB explicitly opts out of third-party credential evaluation for Summer/Fall2026 onward, so central requirement is not imposed. International applicants encouraged by department to send official transcripts at application to prevent later delays; central says officials required after offer.

funding.note: Programme describes PhD stipends,full tuition waiver,affordable health/dental coverage and TA availability for every accepted PhD student. No numeric stipend or explicit international guarantee established; separate TA English proof applies.
